en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a lively outdoor scene. There is an ornate stage with Middle Eastern-inspired architecture and an orchestra or band performing. Next to the stage is a hexagonal gazebo surrounded by trees. Numerous empty chairs are arranged in front of the stage and gazebo, indicating a venue for public gatherings or concerts. The top right corner of the image has the printed word 'Sundsvall,' and there is handwritten text both at the top and across the bottom of the card. The reverse side includes Swedish text, a 5 öre Swedish stamp, and postmarks from Sundsvall and Luleå, addressed to a hotel in Luleå.
